policy.domain_region: Only region/cn-domain is a regional non-IP product. Other regions contain IP lists only.
policy.upstream: Use selected mature routing classifications directly; no root identity gate, voting or CN subtraction.
policy.ru_services: Russian service classifications remain category/ru-services, never region/ru domain rules.

groups.name: 俄罗斯服务
groups.purpose: DLC 成熟俄罗斯服务/市场分类；与全球类别重叠，不是 IP 地域定位。

selectors.field_semantics: Upstream curated Russian-market/service-routing classification, never a physical-server-country assertion. A missing listing in another catalogue is not negative evidence.

groups.name: 中国大陆非 IP
groups.description: Configured mainland routing/service domain rules; IP geography is a separate product.
groups.purpose: 中国大陆非 IP 规则；保留选定上游域名语义，可与服务商及全球类别重叠。
groups.domain_semantics: Selected upstream market and routing-use classifications; not physical server geography.

exception_notes.gov.cn and edu.cn: Retain these mature named institutional namespaces as mainland government/education routing scope; this is not a whole .cn shortcut or a server-location claim.
exception_notes.dotless_suffixes: Generic and branded TLD shortcuts are reported separately and not automatically promoted to regional membership.
